latest_substantive_result.summary: The continuation narrows the earlier severe mixed-source GaAs loss result to its stated tuple and rejects a universal pointwise intrinsic-loss floor from causality/passivity/FDT alone by a scoped gapped, bath-coupled model. Conditional spectral-floor and finite-pump/reset bounds remain. Thermal transport fluctuations persist in the stated thermal-input model. For the selected 2017 Josephson tuple, the source’s converter-only heat extraction is about 1.7982 aW at C=1, but the attempted open-device-port two-RLC thermal interface predicts a 59.0615 aW hot–cold bypass near 4.890417 GHz. A distinct-port JRM removes that specific loop only; pump, isolation and full-cycle performance remain open. No refrigerator advantage is established.
